# Third Year Anthropology · Source Guide

> Course-by-course reading map for BSS Anthropology 3rd Year (ANTH 301–308) at Jahangirnagar University, with unit outlines from the official syllabus and direct links to PDFs and notes on Google Drive.

## Courses

- [ANTH 301 — Contemporary Theoretical Trends in Anthropology](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JQjVrNihoulyokuud-0e5adMNS23ikLm)
- [ANTH 302 — Peasant Society and Culture](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nC9Ja2xz8wAVpUZcj1V9_QXQ6t2Hs_7y)
- [ANTH 303 — Gender: Theories and Issues](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tcab34RtGnCOJfRTlpQoGqpXDRu1gyA_)
- [ANTH 304 — Production Systems and Their Transformations](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hJ_Ka-FejLTHYOVqiKFFRE0UWzJzDvqq)
- [ANTH 305 — Religion and Society](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kBnXK98jOId8ykn0GiKIq3YA_oQZQBX7)
- [ANTH 306 — Political Movements and Collective Identities](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SMpdwthywH04Uyj47vNzpWkpA-wNwd35)
- [ANTH 307 — Language, Society and Culture](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YdQGJi6BrvQPYqsWKwZhQm3cCrO7g6Bn)
- [ANTH 308 — Ethnography: Selected Texts](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1j1nNUWA94yeeSE7MkZDzRgaEPwGW2C0g)
